intro_beach.text: You wake up, washed ashore on a lonely beach, naked as a newborn. Your skull pounds like a war drum and nausea twists your guts. You look left, then right: nothing but sand and sea. You try to remember what happened, but nothing comes. Absolutely nothing.

choices.text: Force your mind to remember who you are and what happened.

amnesia_realization.text: You dig deep into your memories, but your mind goes blank immediately. You cannot recall your past, the people you loved or hated, nor a single detail of your previous life. Even your own name escapes you. Just as despair creeps in, something metallic and shiny buried in the sand catches your eye: a broken medallion. A short sentence is engraved in the back. You read it.

choices.text: "Do not forget where you come from, my dear [USERNAME]."

decide_to_leave_beach.text:
A sharp flash hits you: you recognize that name. It is yours. This is your name ! You have no idea who gave you this medallion, but it is the only lead you have. You hang it around your neck and take a deep breath. Staying on this empty shore will not bring your memories back. You turn away from the waves and head toward the rocky coast. An imposing wall of stone rises ahead of you. If you want to leave the beach, you will have to overcome this obstacle.
What do you choose ?

choices.text: Try to climb the rocky wall anyway. (Strength DC 15)
Scan the area for a clever way up. (Intelligence DC 12)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_climb_success.text: You decide to climb the wall by brute force. You grab onto the rock and start pulling yourself up, one painful movement at a time. You slip more than once, scraping your hands and feet, but stubbornness pushes you onward. After a long and difficult struggle, you finally reach the top, panting and exhausted.

choices.text: Catch your breath and look at what lies ahead.

rock_climb_fail.text: You attempt to climb the wall despite your aching muscles. it's going fine for a while, but when the top is at arm's length, those very arms of yours give up and you fall, head first, into the warm but fortunately soft sand. The easy way isn't going to cut it for you. You'll need to find another way up.

choices.text: Scan the area for a clever way up. (Intelligence DC 12)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_search_solution_success.text: You take a step back and carefully study the surroundings. After a moment, you notice two useful elements: a thick, old tree trunk at the top of the cliff and a long vine at your feet. You throw the vine around the trunk with a careful swing. It holds firm. Using it as a rope, you climb the wall with far less risk and reach the top, still tired but in one piece.

choices.text: Turn toward the land beyond the cliff.

rock_search_solution_fail.text: You analyze your surroundings. Besides a few wandering crabs and algae, you eye catches nothing of value. The smart way up is out of the question.

choices.text: Try to climb the rocky wall anyway. (Strength DC 15)
Play it safe and look for another path along the cliff. (HP Penalty)

rock_long_way.text: You choose caution over bravado and follow the cliff face, searching for any sign of a natural passage. You walk and walk, your legs growing heavier with each step. At last, hidden in the rock, you find an old stone stairway carved into the cliff. Every step burns what little energy you have left, but you eventually emerge at the top, drained but alive.

choices.text: Look around from the top of the cliffs.

cliff_top.text:
At the top, you take one last look at the endless ocean stretching toward the horizon. There is no turning back now. Ahead of you, two paths present themselves. To your left: a misty bridge crossing a deep ravine, its planks old and suspicious. To your right: a dark forest, thick with twisted trees and shadows hiding who-knows-what.
Pick your route.

choices.text: Take the misty, fragile bridge.
Enter the dark, unnerving forest.

bridge_start.text: You step onto the bridge. The old wooden plank groans under your weight. A second step, then a third. Strange, distant cries rise from the abyss, chilling your blood. Still, you press on, one careful step at a time. Just as the far side of the ravine finally comes into view, one last crack rings out. The bridge gives way beneath your feet. You fall into the void, arms flailing.

choices.text: Think quick. Reach out for anything that might save you.
Scream your lungs out, as if your shout could overcome gravity.
Close your eyes and accept the end.

saved_from_fall.text: As you plummet, a hand bursts through the mist and grabs your wrist at the last possible moment. With a grunt, someone hauls you toward the cliff edge. You slam against the rock, coughing and shaking, then climb up with your rescuer’s help. As you calm your nerve, collapsed on the ground, another helping hand is offered to you.

choices.text: Accept the help and stand up. You want to take a better look at the person who saved your life.
Push the hand away and stand up, painfully, on your own.

saved_from_fall_scream.text: As you plummet and strain your vocal chords screaming, a hand bursts through the mist and grabs your wrist at the last possible moment. With a grunt, someone hauls you toward the cliff edge. You slam against the rock, coughing and shaking, then climb up with your rescuer’s help. As you calm your nerve, collapsed on the ground, another helping hand is offered to you.

choices.text: Accept the help and stand up. You want to take a better look at the person who saved your life.
Push the hand away and stand up, painfully, on your own. You don't need any help.

bandits_appear.text:
You manage to stand. The man who saved you studies you in silence. His eyes stop on your medallion. He whistles. A dozen rough-looking figures appear from the fog and the rocks around you, surrounding you in a tight circle. They are all armed and grinning. You finally understand: these are bandits, and your savior is their leader. He pulls out a blade and points it at your chest. No words needed. Your medallion or your life.
You need to think fast. What do you do ?

choices.text: You won't play the hero. Hand over the medallion without resisting.
Refuse and prepare to fight, even if it means dying here. This medallion is the only lead you have.
These bandits don't look too bright. Attempt to negotiate with a well-crafted lie. (Charisma DC 15)

bandits_take_medallion.text: You accept your fate and hand over the medallion to the bandit leader. He snatches it from your fingers and raises it for everyone to see, basking in the greed of his men. After slipping the medallion into his pouch, he gives you a cruel look. His words make it clear: giving the medallion does not guarantee your survival.

choices.text: Take a deep breath and wait for whatever comes next.
Start crying and begging for your life. You never know.

stand_your_ground.text: You tighten your fists and square your shoulders. You will not let them take the medallion without a fight. The bandits laugh at the sight of a naked, exhausted stranger trying to look threatening. One of them steps forward, ready to smash your face in. Outnumbered and unarmed, you know the outcome is already written in blood.

choices.text: Keep your guard up and get ready to cough some of your teeth.

stand_your_ground_fighter.text: You tighten your fists and square your shoulders. You will not let them take the medallion without a fight. The bandits laugh at the sight of a naked, exhausted stranger trying to look threatening. One of them steps forward, ready to smash your face in. Outnumbered and unarmed, you know the outcome is already written in blood.

choices.text: [FIGHTER] Use a stick as an improvised weapon, then demonstrate some of your swordplay skill in the hope of scaring them away.
Keep your guard up and get ready to cough some of your teeth.

attempt_fireball_success.text:
You reach deep into your fractured memories for a simple fire spell, the very first lesson of most young mages. The formula somehow surfaces in your mind, the words shaky but complete. A small spark appears in your hand and engulfs one of the foes in flames. His charred body falls on the floor. One down, thirteen bandits to go. Thirteen pissed off bandits at that.
You have now unlocked Fireball !

choices.text: Face the bandits’ reaction to your magic.

attempt_fireball_fail.text: You reach deep into your fractured memories for a simple fire spell, the very first lesson of most young mages. The formula surfaces in your mind, shaky but complete. You mutter the words, a small spark appears in your hand and bursts into...nothing. Just a puff of smoke. The bandits laugh at you in unission, still determined to end you.

choices.text: Brace yourself for the inevitable.

attempt_negotiation_success.text: With a calm voice, you tell the bandits a story: a powerful wizard grants eternal life to whoever brings him your medallion. But only one of them can claim immortality. The bait is cast. The leader wants the reward for himself, his men disagree. They turn on one another, screaming, slashing, bleeding. Only one remains, the leader, drenched in blood and panting heavily.

choices.text: Use this opportunity to slip away.
Pick a rock at your feet and use it as a weapon.

attempt_negotiation_fail.text: You clear you throat, then mumble a ridiculous story about a wizard who enjoys sausages and beer. The armed men stare at you in disbelief. 'What a moron', they probably all think. You sigh; this is a total disaster. The bandits, pissed that you dared open your mouth, will cut out your tongue first.

choices.text: Brace yourself for the inevitable.

eden_rescue_bandits.text: The bandits close in, ready to strike. Just as the first blow is about to fall, an arrow whistles through the air and buries itself in a bandit’s throat. A second arrow follows, then a third. The men around you fall in confusion and terror as arrows rain down on them. In the chaos, the leader seizes you and uses you as a living shield. Soon after, a final arrow sinks deep in his back. He stiffens and drop on the floor—Out, but still breathing.

choices.text: Grab your medallion back and look at the pile of corpses at your feet, trying to understand what just happened.
Quickly get your medallion and search for the archer ; he might come for you too.

eden_rescue_bandits_swordplay.text: Your poor man's sword swirl and twirl around your waist in an rusty but elegant manner. Your show of strength keep the bandits at bay, just long enough until, suddenly, an arrow lodges itself inside one of the bandits. A second arrow follows, then a third. Chaos ensues, the bandits drop like flies. The leader vainly tries to locate the archer, but a final arrow cuts his search short. He falls unconscious, leaving you the only one left standing.

choices.text: Look at the pile of corpses at your feet, trying to understand what just happened.
Search for the archer ; he might come for you too.

eden_rescue_bandits_negotiation.text: Before you could try anything, an arrow brushes past your cheek and ends its course into the leader's back. The bandit collapses on the floor, unconscious. Footsteps behind you, calm and unhurried. A whistle. A confident man steps out of his hiding place and calmly surveys the bodies scattered around you, nodding once as if inspecting a job already done. He checks the leader's pulse, pulls out his last used arrow, then finally notices your presence. He laughs.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

forest_entry.text: You choose the forest. You gather what courage you have left and step into the tangle of dark trees. The shadows swallow you whole. Strange animal cries echo between the trunks, making you jump. You force yourself to breathe slowly and keep moving, deeper into the woods.

choices.text: Continue along the narrow forest path.

spider_web.text: After nearly an hour of walking, you stumble upon a gigantic spiderweb stretching from tree to tree, thick as a curtain. You push aside some of the silk and freeze. A monstrous spider is at work, wrapping one of its prey in webbing. Not just any prey: a frail elf, whose twisted body shows he died slowly and painfully.

choices.text: Retreat carefully and try to hide without making a sound. (Dexterity DC 15)
Grab a sturdy branch and let out a menacing roar. (Charisma DC 18)
Try to recall a basic fire spell and use magic. (Intelligence DC 12)

hide_from_spider_fail.text: You slowly back away, watching every step you take. But then, a dry twig cracks under your foot and your heart stops. Alerted, the spider notices you immediately. It screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

hide_from_spider_success.text: You slowly back away, watching every step you take. Suddenly, you freeze. You were this close to stepping on a dry twig. You walk carefully around it and slip behind a tree. When the creature is done with its meal, it drops the lifeless elf from its web and begins to crawl along the silk strands, searching for a new position.

choices.text: Stay hidden and hope it moves away.

scaring_spider_success.text: You snatch up a thick branch and brandish it like a makeshift spear. Then, you scream at the giant spider in a deep, threatening voice. The beast jumps then freezes. It examines you, not knowing if confronting a scary beast like you is worth its life. Finally, the spider obeys its survival instinct and climbs on the webbed trees. You take this opportunity to hide behind a tree.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

scaring_spider_fail.text: You snatch up a thick branch and brandish it like a makeshift spear. Then, you scream at the giant spider in a deep, threatening voice. At least, you try. Your voice breaks like the one of a teenager. The beast, not impressed at all, screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Face what seems to be your end.

forest_attempt_fireball_success.text:
You close your eyes and let your mind drift through broken memories. A basic fire spell surfaces: the first trick taught to young mages. You whisper the incantation and focus. A tiny flame appears in your hand and leaps toward the spider. It would have worked, if the creature wasn't so quick on its feet. It steps back right on time and then turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.
You have now unlocked Fireball !

choices.text: Look for a last-second miracle.

forest_attempt_fireball_fail.text: You close your eyes and let your mind drift through broken memories. A basic fire spell surfaces: the first trick taught to young mages. You whisper the incantation and focus. But nothing happens. If a spider could laugh, it would certainly do it. But instead, the creature screeches and turns on you with murderous rage, knocking you to the ground and pinning you.

choices.text: Look for a last-second miracle.

eden_rescue_spider_hide.text: Still hidden behind your tree, you watch the spider move along its web, looking for a new angle, perhaps another prey. Suddenly, an arrow flies out of the undergrowth and pierces one of its eyes. The beast lets out a horrible screech. A second arrow slams into its abdomen, then a third. Each shot is precise and deliberate. The spider convulses and collapses onto the forest floor.

choices.text: Step out of your hiding place.

eden_rescue_spider_danger.text: The spider looms above you, ready to plunge its fangs into your flesh. Just as it strikes, an arrow whistles past your ear and buries itself in one of its many eyes. The beast rears back in agony. Another arrow slams into its body, then another. You shield your face as the monstrous creature collapses on top of you, dead weight pressing the air from your lungs.

choices.text: Struggle out from under the corpse.

eden_appears_common.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly pulls his arrows from the fresh corpses of the bandits. He walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the unconscious leader at your feet. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

eden_appears_common_negotiation.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly surveys the bodies scattered around you, nodding once as if inspecting a job already done. A shy beard cover half his face, greasy long hair hides the other half. An eyepatch hides his left eye. The hunter walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the unconscious leader at your feet. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

eden_appears_forest.text: You hear a cheerful whistle and a finger snap before you see anyone. A man steps out of his hiding place and calmly pulls his arrows from the corpse of the giant spider. A shy beard cover half his face, greasy long hair hides the other half. An eyepatch hides his left eye. The hunter walks past you at first, ignoring you as if you were just another piece of scenery. Then he stops by the broken body of the elf still tangled in the web. Only then does he turn toward you. He starts laughing.

choices.text: Take a proper look at your savior.

choices.text: Put some clothes on you, then ask who he is and what he is doing here.
Get dressed, while thanking him for saving your life.

choices.text: Put some clothes on you, then ask who he is and what he is doing here.
Get dressed, while thanking him for saving your life.
[FEMALE] Call him a pervert then hide behind a rock to get dressed with a little privacy.

choices.text: Follow him to his horse. Then heave the body over the saddle.

choices.text: Follow him outside the forest to his horse.

Now, give me a hand, would ya' ? Bloke's too heavy for me."

choices.text: Follow him to his horse. Then heave the body over the saddle.

choices.text: Follow him to his horse. Then heave the body over the saddle.

So stumbling upon this four-legged demon was a blessing... and stumbling upon you as well, of course, ahem. You want a lift to the nearest town, I reckon ? Follow me."

choices.text: Follow him outside the forest to his horse.

eden_explains_hunt_forest_alt.text: ??? : "Okay... I see you're not the friendly and grateful type. I'm a bounty hunter, stranger, and I've just bagged my latest prey. I was heading back to the nearest city, cutting through this forest, when I noticed those webs above us. The venom of these creatures makes the perfect sleeping draught, ideal for someone in my line of work. Now, I'm heading back on the road. Care to join me ? Unless getting devoured by spiders is your thing. Not judging. ".

choices.text: Follow him outside the forest to his horse.

eden_ask_for_player_story.text: ??? : "Thanks... dragging the bodies is always the worst part of my job, and it's not like I'm getting any younger. Tell me, what's your story, stranger? Not that I really care, but I'm curious to know what a clown like you is doing, naked, in the middle of these wild lands."

choices.text: Tell him about your amnesia and how you woke up on the beach...without clothes.

eden_to_horse_forest.text: ??? : " There we are. What's your story? Not that I really care, but I'm curious to know what went through your head when you decided to wander about with your bossom out in the open ?"

choices.text: Tell him about your amnesia and how you woke up on the beach... without clothes.

eden_reacts_amnesia.text: ??? : " Amnesia, huh ? Interesting. You don't see that everyday. My name's Eden, if that matters. What's yours ?

choices.text: Be honest and give him your name.
Lie and pretend you don't remember that either.

name_not_given_eden_ride_to_city.text: Eden : "That figures ! Sorry I even asked. Anyway... I long for some ale, I'm sure you do too. With the fat bounty I'm about to collect, I might even be kind enough to buy the first round. Now, get your ass on that horse before I change my mind."

choices.text: Climb behind him and hold on tight.

name_given_eden_ride_to_city.text: Eden : "Well met ! You must be hungry... and thirsty. The bounty on Regalus will pay for the first round. The nearest city is about two hours away, so I hope your backside can handle the ride."

choices.text: Climb behind him and hold on tight.

crossing_on_horseback.text: You ride across the valley at full speed. In the back, Regalus, the bandit leader, snores peacefully despite the jolts of the road. After several hours on horseback, you reach Kelia's Crossing, a small elven town ringed by immense fortifications, almost cut off from the rest of the world. Two elven legionaries stop you at the gate : no one is to enter in the city without a pass. One of the guards spots the blood on your clothes. His hand reaches for his sword...

choices.text: Tell him you injured yourself hiking.
Assure him that you fought a grizzly bear in the wilds, and this blood is not yours.
Warn him to look the other way or else things might get bloody for him too.

crossing_on_horseback_orc.text: You ride across the valley at full speed. In the back, Regalus, the bandit leader, snores peacefully despite the jolts of the road. After several hours on horseback, you reach Kelia's Crossing, a small elven town ringed by immense fortifications, almost cut off from the rest of the world. Two elven legionaries stop you at the gate : no one is to enter in the city without a pass. One of the guards, who obviously have a disdain for Orcs like you, spots the blood on your clothes. An orc with blood on him ? He reaches for his sword, ready to use it.

choices.text: Tell him you injured yourself hiking.
Assure him that you fought a grizzly bear in the wilds, and this blood is not yours.
Warn him to look the other way or else things might get bloody for him too.

elf_and_eden_talk_threat.text:
The guard curses you and draws his sword. Eden quickly intervenes. He nods toward the criminal tied to the back of his horse. The legionary immediately recognizes the sleeping bandit. Tensions ease. They let you enter, and one of the guard escorts you to the town hall.
The city is dead silent. The air heavy. Streets empty. The shops; all closed—a real ghost town. After a short walk, you reach the town hall. At the sight of Regalus, now fully awake and grunting, the Mayor rejoices.

choices.text: [CONTINUE]

elf_and_eden_talk.text:
Eden nods toward the criminal tied to the back of his horse. The legionary immediately recognizes the sleeping bandit. Tensions ease. They let you enter, and one of the guard escorts you to the town hall.
The city is dead silent. The air heavy. Streets empty. The shops; all closed—a real ghost town. After a short walk, you reach the town hall. At the sight of Regalus, now fully awake and grunting, the Mayor rejoices.

choices.text: [CONTINUE]

introducing_to_mayor.text:
The Mayor : "I had to see it for myself; that scoundrel Regalus, finally apprehended! Do you know how many people he robbed and killed ? You probably don't. But too many. Here's the reward, as promised. To tell you the honest truth, this vermin doesn't deserve to rot in jail. Here's my hunting knife. Hunters, spare us all a senseless trial : kill him now. "
Eden steps back and throws you a sly look : he wants you to make the choice. What do you do ?

choices.text: Accept the blade and cut Regalus' throat.
Refuse the blade. You will not kill him.

killing_regalus.text: You accept the Mayor's knife. With a swift, decisive motion, you slice Regalus's throat. The criminal convulses, choking on his own blood as it spills at your feet. After a long, agonizing minute, his body goes rigid. The Mayor watches in silence, then gives you a solemn nod of approval, clearly relieved and grateful that someone else has taken this burden upon themselves. His men quickly drag the corpse away. Eden doesn't utter a word. He just smirks.

choices.text: Boast that you enjoy removing parasites like him from the world.
Complain that, even thought it felt necessary, you would rather avoid killing.
Pocket the knife while the Mayor is not looking. (Dexterity DC 15)

pocket_the_mayor_knife.text:
With a flick of the wrist, you hide the knife up your sleeve, right under the Mayor's nose. Eden catches you in the act, but doesn't care enough to do anything. When the Mayor turns his attention back to you, his weapon has disappeared, unbeknowst to him.
